notes.title: 【Important Notice】 How to avoid getting a program crash when converting to Japan
notes.content:
There is an error reported that the program may crash when inputting Japanese characters.
If this error occurs, you would be able to avoid by taking either one of the following measures:

■Revert 'Microsoft ME' to the previous version
1. Click Windows 'Start' button
2. Click 'Setting'
3. 'Time & Language' > 'Language' > 'Microsoft IME' > 'General' > turn on 'Use previous version Microsoft IME'

■Disable 'Optional diagnostic data' option
1. Click Windows 'Start' button
2. Click 'Setting'
3. 'Privacy' > 'Diagnostics & feedback' > turn off 'Optional diagnostic data'

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.
